Hi Jamie / infra team,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — appreciated the context on your compliance and throughput needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a technical deep dive scheduled: 

- Recap: you need a private deployment (VPC) for production inference, KMS integration for keys, and audit logs retained for 7 years. Expected steady-state qps ~200 requests/sec with occasional spikes to ~1.2k rps.
- Goals for next call: walk through Private/VPC network architecture options, firewall and peering patterns, and confirm our recommended deployment size + scaling policy.
- Attendees we suggest: your infra lead + security/compliance, our Solutions Engineer (Vivek Kulkarni), and me.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Jul 15, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed Jul 16, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Can you confirm which works for your team and who will join from Acme? I attached a short pre-call checklist that will help Vivek prepare (network ranges, current VPC layout, expected concurrency).

If those times don't work, share 2-3 windows that do and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
